ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a population change curve graph with time as the horizontal axis and wild turkey population size as the vertical axis. There is a bold horizontal reference line on the graph, and the population curve rises from a lower position and intersects this bold horizontal line at the position labeled C. Reasoning: In an ecological population-time graph, the horizontal reference line that represents the maximum stable population size that the environment can maintain over the long term is called carrying capacity. Therefore, the bold horizontal line intersected by point C is called carrying capacity.
